title: A Study of the Natural Progression of Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)
off: A Study of the Natural Progression of Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)
collabs: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis Clinical Research Network
National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
summary: We propose to acquire data and blood samples on all patients being cared for by the Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD) program. Additionally, we will collect data and blood samples from a control group for comparator purposes. In doing so, we will be able to describe the "phenotypic" expression of these diseases.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Interstitial lung disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not have Interstitial lung disease

primary.m: Natural history of course of disease in patients with Interstitial lung disease (ILD)
